compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: shell/bash RED test not reproducing under run-hermetic.sh triggers HARD-GATE full stop (impl halts, "Hermetic reproduction failed" comment, restart Phase C); non-shell emits "HERMETIC_SKIP: runner=<runner> reason=non-shell", never blocked. Shell iff .sh suffix OR resolved $TEST_CMD runner starts with bash|sh.

(Shared with task-5b, which owns the Phase E SKILL.md wiring of this gate. This task owns the run-hermetic.sh helper script behavior.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh: given a RED test path and the resolved $TEST_CMD, determine shell-ness (shell iff the test has a .sh suffix OR the resolved $TEST_CMD runner starts with bash|sh). For shell tests, run the test under hermetic isolation and exit 0 only if it reproduces; exit non-zero if it does not reproduce (the caller uses this to trigger the HARD-GATE full stop). For non-shell tests, emit exactly 'HERMETIC_SKIP: runner=<runner> reason=non-shell' and exit 0 (never blocked). Implement until tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh (task-4a) passes. Set the executable bit on the new script.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New script is executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh
- [ ] Script is bash -n clean — Verify: bash -n plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh
- [ ] task-4a test now passes GREEN — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh
- [ ] Non-shell path emits the exact HERMETIC_SKIP line — Verify: grep -qE 'HERMETIC_SKIP: runner=.* reason=non-shell' plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
